items.title: 2026/2027 academic year begins in September
items.excerpt: Resumption date and term dates have been shared with parents; new pupils should complete admission by the last week of August.

items.title: Inter-house sports day held on campus
items.excerpt: Pupils from Creche, Pre Nursery, Nursery, Primary School and Secondary School competed across four houses, with the closing ceremony held in the school field.

items.title: Secondary pupils sit mock WAEC/NECO papers
items.excerpt: Mock exams were held ahead of this year's external examinations to prepare SS3 students.

items.title: Cultural Day celebration
items.excerpt: Pupils celebrated Nigeria's rich cultural heritage with performances and exhibitions.

items.title: New term resumption notice
items.excerpt: Second term resumption date and requirements were circulated to all parents.
